sites.meaning: Branch to an ownership/abort-quarantine guard, retaining all transfer wrappers and original MMIO ordering.

Ownership and per-channel abort-quarantine guard, plus fixed recovery entry at RVA 0x6fd0. Real observer reads and accessible writes remain stock; inaccessible writes return vendor denied with zero bytes. Writable quarantine bitmap uses originally zero padding at RVA 0x9f00..0x9f80.

evidence.reference: Working supplied Y703 image has all 24576 SPMI .text bytes identical to TB520FU stock; it does not stub transfer functions.
evidence.live_TWRP: Arbiter version 0x70010000, features0 0x80060380, features1 0x80; bus0=896, bus1=128. APID 0x4c PPID 0x183 owner=4, APID 0x277 PPID 0x021 owner=0, AP EE=0.
evidence.fault: Earlier fault at SPMI+0x37f0 on write STATUS 0x0c54c008 matches the unowned 0x4c channel. An earlier APID 0x277 fault was on an AP-owned channel. The v21 command-first hypothesis was subsequently insufficient, as the next photo shows a WDATA0 abort.
evidence.v21_tablet: ESR 0x96000010, FAR 0x0c77a010, ELR 0x1f31844. Relative RVA 0x3844 is the WDATA0 STR for APID 0x27a. Command-first ordering did not resolve channel access; v22 restores the stock preflight STATUS read.

limitations: A narrow CPU exception fixup converts only reviewed synchronous external aborts inside this exact SPMI raw-transfer frame to vendor denied. Faulting write channels are quarantined; observer reads and other write channels stay enabled. This contains inaccessible MMIO, not a repair of the underlying hardware access policy. USB VBUS still depends on accessible power paths. Tablet validation pending.
